svg.title: How Finance Overview works
svg.desc: Four lanes of a pool: 1, export a CSV from your bank; 2, import it in your browser, where duplicates are skipped, categories learn and own transfers are left out; 3, it stays on your device; 4, optionally sync it, encrypted with your passphrase so Cloudflare only stores ciphertext.

g.text: Export a CSV from your bank
ING and Revolut are recognised. Other banks: match the columns once.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Duplicates are skipped, categories learn, own transfers are left out.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Kept in your browser, or on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Sync it encrypted, if you like
Locked with your passphrase first. Cloudflare only stores ciphertext.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
